about: The epistola of the formulary “Saints Simon and Jude, Apostles” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: Grace has been given to every one of us in the measure of Christ’s giving. For this reason it is said: Ascending on high, He led captivity captive; He gave gifts to men. But that He ascended, what is it, except that He also descended first into the lower regions of the earth? The One who descended is Himself the One who also ascended above all the heavens, so as to fill all things. And it was He who gave some indeed as apostles, some as prophets, others, in turn, as evangelists, and still others as shepherds and teachers, for the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the building up of Christ’s body, until all of us come together into the unity of faith and of knowing the Son of God, into a perfect man, into the measure of the age of Christ’s fullness.
